name: Chisleu
overview: Chisleu is identified in Scripture as the ninth month of the Israelitish calendar, marking a significant time in the biblical narrative. In Ezra 10:9, it is the setting for a solemn gathering of the men of Judah and Benjamin in Jerusalem, highlighting a moment of communal repentance and reverence. Nehemiah 1:1 situates the beginning of Nehemiah's account in this month, emphasizing its historical importance. Jeremiah 36:22 also references the ninth month as a time of quiet reflection, with the king sitting by a fire in the winterhouse, suggesting a season of contemplation during the colder months.
